title: Atalanta v Parma: Sarri warns against underestimating Parma
standfirst: Maurizio Sarri says Atalanta want to build "a new, great cycle", but his squad is stretched by injuries, Gianluca Scamacca among them.

title: Lecce 1-2 Genoa: Osmajic and Messias give Genoa the win
standfirst: Genoa went two up inside half an hour at the Via del Mare and held on after Youssef Maleh's free-kick.

title: Lommel 2-0 Gent: two late goals in five minutes
standfirst: Juho Talvitie and Djordje Gordic scored in the last eight minutes as Lommel beat Gent at the Soeverein Stadion.

title: Lorient v Brest: the postponed Breton derby
standfirst: The derby was postponed during the eighth round of Ligue 1, and Brest come in after a home defeat to Nice.

title: Gil Vicente v Vitória de Guimarães: Luís Pinto faces his former club
standfirst: Gil Vicente coach Luís Pinto meets the side he won the Allianz Cup with, and two key players could return to his team.

title: Trabzonspor 2-0 Gaziantep: Savic and Muçi score
standfirst: Stefan Savic scored just before half-time and Ernest Muçi doubled the lead as Trabzonspor beat Gaziantep at Papara Park.

title: Académico de Viseu 2-1 Rio Ave: Messeguem and Clóvis turn it around
standfirst: Rio Ave led at half-time, but two goals in eight minutes gave Académico de Viseu the win at the Estádio do Fontelo.

title: New England v Inter Miami: Messi cleared to play
standfirst: An MLS rule lets Lionel Messi play despite a fifth yellow card, with Chicago Fire one point behind Inter Miami in the East.

title: Marítimo 0-2 Santa Clara: Ribeiro and Lopes win it in Funchal
standfirst: Tiago Ribeiro scored before half-time and Vinícius Lopes struck from outside the box as Santa Clara won at the Estádio do Marítimo.

title: STVV 1-2 OH Leuven: two missed penalties and a late sucker punch
standfirst: Dani van den Heuvel saved two first-half penalties at Stayen, and Davis Opoku's late goal handed Sint-Truiden a fifth straight league defeat.

title: Belgrano v Barracas Central: hosts look to end a two-game slide
standfirst: Belgrano have lost their last two league games without scoring, while Barracas Central arrive unbeaten in four.

title: Deportivo v Osasuna: Arrasate promises changes
standfirst: Jagoba Arrasate expects an Osasuna side "faithful to its identity" at Riazor on Monday, after a 2-0 defeat at Sevilla.

title: Newcastle v Everton: a quick rematch after Everton's 3-1 win
standfirst: Newcastle host Everton on Monday night, four days after losing 3-1 away to the same opponents.

title: Benfica v Alverca: Marco Silva's side chase a fifth straight win
standfirst: Benfica have won four in a row in all competitions, while Alverca coach Sérgio Ferreira says his side must be "very consistent" at the Estádio da Luz.

title: Racing Santander 0-3 Real Madrid: Mbappé, Bellingham and Diomande seal it early
standfirst: Real Madrid were three goals up by the 36th minute at El Sardinero and moved back within three points of leaders Barcelona.

title: Excelsior 0-9 FC Twente: Weghorst scores four after early red card
standfirst: Wout Weghorst scored four times and Sondre Ørjasæter provided five assists as ten-man Excelsior were overwhelmed at Woudestein.

title: Strasbourg 5-1 Auxerre: Yassine scores twice as Strasbourg run riot
standfirst: Gessime Yassine scored twice and set up another as Strasbourg beat ten-man Auxerre 5-1 at the Stade de la Meinau.

title: Getafe 3-1 Sevilla: Ünal and Satriano turn it round late
standfirst: Enes Ünal and Martín Satriano set each other up in five minutes after Kike Salas had given Sevilla the lead, and Orel Mangala added a third in stoppage time.

standfirst: Gustav Isaksen equalised before half-time and Andrea Pinamonti headed the winner in the 83rd minute after M'Bala Nzola had put Cagliari ahead.

title: Frosinone 2-0 Torino: Ghedjemis and Calò goals earn home win
standfirst: Farès Ghedjemis scored early in the second half and Giacomo Calò added a late second as Frosinone outshot Torino 20-12.

title: Union Berlin 1-1 Cologne: El Mala equalises late at the Alte Försterei
standfirst: Janik Haberer gave Union an early lead, but Malek El Mala levelled from a corner in the 79th minute.

title: Telstar 4-2 Utrecht: hosts score four in six-goal thriller
standfirst: Tyrone Owusu, Abdelnour Soualhia, Nökkvi Thórisson and Ar'Jany Martha scored as Telstar beat Utrecht with only 34.7 per cent of the ball.

title: Basaksehir 5-2 Samsunspor: five different scorers for the hosts
standfirst: Eldor Shomurodov, Andreas Skov Olsen, Emin Bayram, Ousseynou Ba and Abbosbek Fayzullaev scored as Basaksehir beat Samsunspor.

title: Amed SFK 5-1 Eyupspor: Ballet hat-trick, then a late red card
standfirst: Samuel Ballet scored three times, including a penalty, before being sent off in stoppage time as Amed beat Eyupspor in Diyarbakir.

title: Cercle Brugge 2-1 Antwerp: Akinsola double after the break
standfirst: Babatunde Akinsola scored twice in the second half and Cercle held on after Modibo Fofana's late goal for Antwerp.

title: PEC Zwolle 1-0 ADO Den Haag: Mbayo goal on the stroke of half-time
standfirst: Dylan Mbayo scored from Younes Namli's pass in the 45th minute as Zwolle won with only a third of the ball.

title: Arouca 1-0 Nacional: Esgaio header from a set piece

title: Barcelona 6-1 Alavés: Raphinha and Lamine Yamal both score twice

title: Moreirense 2-1 Estrela: Nile John settles it in stoppage time
standfirst: Nile John's strike from outside the box five minutes into stoppage time gave Moreirense victory over the pre-match favourites.

title: Erzurum BB 1-3 Çorum FK: Ramírez double earns away win

title: PSV Eindhoven 7-0 Willem II: seven different scorers in Eindhoven rout

title: Real Betis 2-1 Málaga: Bartra and Fornals strike from set pieces

standfirst: Arsenal arrive at Anfield after a midweek cup exit at Fleetwood, while Liverpool are unbeaten in five.

title: Racing Santander v Real Madrid: Mbappé storm follows the leaders' run
standfirst: Real Madrid have won five in a row, but the build-up has been dominated by Kylian Mbappé's apology and a broadcasting row in China.

title: Juventus v Napoli: Spalletti under pressure after Genoa defeat

title: Athletic Club v Real Sociedad: the first Basque derby of the season

title: Eintracht Frankfurt v Hamburg: a rematch five days after the cup tie

title: Lecce v Genoa: De Rossi's side ride the Juventus win
standfirst: Genoa beat Juventus 2-0 in midweek; Lecce have lost four of their last five.

title: Elche v Valencia: Aguirre still chasing a first win
standfirst: Valencia are winless in four, while Elche are unbeaten in five ahead of the derby at the Martínez Valero.

title: Union Berlin v Cologne: a second meeting in five days

standfirst: Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer struck after the break as ten-man Manchester United fell apart at Stamford Bridge.

title: Manchester City 0-1 Brighton: Ayari strike sinks the leaders at the Etihad
standfirst: Yasin Ayari's early finish gave Brighton revenge for their midweek cup exit and handed Manchester City a second straight league defeat.

title: Bologna 2-1 Monza: Skorupski save settles a three-penalty contest

title: Rayo Vallecano 3-0 Celta Vigo: De Frutos double powers Rayo

title: Brentford 2-0 Nottingham Forest: Milenkovic own goal sets up Bees win

title: FC Augsburg 1-2 SC Freiburg: Irié header completes Freiburg comeback

title: AFC Bournemouth 2-0 Leeds United: Trafford error gifts Cherries win

title: Werder Bremen 2-0 TSG Hoffenheim: Füllkrug and Dinkçi strike

title: Borussia Mönchengladbach 0-0 SC Paderborn: Stalemate at Borussia-Park

title: Der Klassiker without Kompany: Danks takes Bayern's bench against Dortmund

title: Juventus v Napoli: Spalletti under pressure, Allegri short at the back

title: Ajax v AZ: Berghuis expected back as Ajax chase a fourth straight win

title: Man City v Brighton: leaders respond to first defeat as Hürzeler's side regroup

title: Aston Villa v Fulham: Jackson and Suzuki carry Villa's feel-good factor
standfirst: Villa beat the league leaders last weekend; Fulham have won two in a row and climbed out of the relegation zone.

title: Lazio v Cagliari: Gattuso's leaders chase more history

title: Marseille v Toulouse: Genesio wants answers after the 4-3 scare against Le Havre
standfirst: Four goals up with half an hour left, Marseille almost threw it all away against bottom side Le Havre. Bruno Genesio has explained why he spared Angel Gomes from criticism.

title: Lyon v Angers: moved for the national day of protest, with injuries piling up

title: Frankfurt v Hamburg: a quick rematch after the cup, and an injury crisis for HSV

title: Schalke v Leipzig: Hwang outburst overshadows Schalke's cup exit

title: Porto v Estoril: Farioli's side still perfect after nine league games
standfirst: Porto bounced back from their Champions League defeat to PSV and remain flawless in the league, with Benfica keeping pace.

title: Lecce v Genoa: De Rossi's Genoa ride a Bijlow wave

title: Elche v Valencia: Aguirre's Valencia still searching for a spark
standfirst: One home win in nine, late defeats and a derby lost in stoppage time: Valencia travel to Elche under pressure.

title: Bournemouth v Leeds: Rose's Cherries on a high after Old Trafford
standfirst: Bournemouth won 3-0 at Manchester United, having already humbled AC Milan. Leeds arrive after a goalless draw at Sunderland.

title: Troyes v Le Mans: Le Mans arrive at the centre of the goal-line row
standfirst: A goal awarded by goal-line technology at Auxerre sparked one of the controversies of the season in France. Le Mans also lose Djibril Sidibé to a broken foot.
